value.rationale: Iterated negation is the canonical unbounded-depth one-variable family for this semantics. The result turns the source's coarse exponential bound into an exact all-depth profile and quantifies how strongly its support refinement can compress a naturally growing initial table: golden-ratio growth collapses to a four-row fixed point.
